title: Add Google AdSense via reusable ad components rendered globally in the content area

requirements.text: Create reusable Google AdSense React components that can be used across the app, including (a) a component that ensures the AdSense script is loaded only once per page load using the provided script tag, and (b) a reusable ad slot component that renders an <ins class="adsbygoogle"> element with configurable props (e.g., ad client, slot id, format, responsive) and triggers adsbygoogle rendering safely.
acceptanceCriteria: A reusable component exists to load the AdSense script once using: <script async src="https://pagead2.googlesyndication.com/pagead/js/adsbygoogle.js?client=ca-pub-8182684208705293" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>.
A reusable AdSlot component exists that can be placed multiple times without crashing the app (guards against missing window.adsbygoogle and multiple pushes).
No backend changes are required for these components.

requirements.text: Render the AdSense components globally across the app in the main content area on all pages/sections, so that ads are inserted within the <main> content flow (not in the HTML <head>). Ensure this global insertion applies to both the standard section-based UI and the referral redirect route.
acceptanceCriteria: When navigating between sections (home/tasks/wallet/profile), the ad rendering remains within the main scrollable content area (inside the app layout’s <main>).
When visiting the referral redirect route (currentSection starting with "r/"), the page still includes the content-area ad insertion without interfering with redirect behavior.
The AdSense script is not duplicated on navigation; it is loaded once per browser page load.

constraints: Do not edit any files under frontend/immutablePaths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui.
Keep all user-facing text in English.
nonGoals: Setting up or verifying Google AdSense account approval, ad inventory, or payment configuration.
Implementing specific ad unit IDs/slots beyond providing a reusable slot component API (unless already available in the project).
Adding any backend (Motoko) support for ads or routing ad rendering through the canister.
